prompt:
UI design mockup of a phone app screen for a model catalogue, portrait. The visual world is a wooden library card catalogue in a reading room.
Layout top to bottom with scale: (1) a slim brass-ruled header with the app name 'V’s MultiGen AI Chat' at the left and the app icon (a speech bubble with an orange spark) at the right; (2) the drawer face: a row of proud index tabs, five visible, one pulled forward and cream-coloured, the rest oak, each tab printed with a facet word - All, Language, Image, Video, Voice/TTS - and a small count under each; (3) a second row of three tabs for the policy facets - Likeness 24, NSFW 20, Native voice 104 - the middle one carrying a red stamp mark; (4) a search field drawn as the drawer's label line: a cream strip with a brass label holder reading 'Search 366 models'; (5) the card stack filling the lower half: three or four cream index cards, each with a ruled top line, a punched hole at the left, a bold typed model name, one line of id in small type, two short capability lines, and small red and blue stamp marks at the right; the top card fully readable.
Real content from the app: facet labels "All", "Language", "Image", "Video", "Voice/TTS", "Music", "Text"; filter labels "Likeness", "NSFW", "Native voice" with option text "Allowed (20)", "Open only (6)", "Blocked (21)"; model names "GPT-6 Luna", "Claude Opus 5.5", "Aion 3.5 Mini", "Grok 4.7", "ElevenLabs Music v2", "MiniMax H3 Max". Style: flat vector interface design, oak and brass cabinet framing a warm cream card stock, typed black spec lines, a red rubber stamp for a rating, a blue stamp for a heading, ruled lines, no photograph, no 3D, no glow, no glass.
